meta.name: azure-quotas
meta.description: Check/manage Azure quotas and usage across providers. For deployment planning, capacity validation, region selection. WHEN: "check quotas", "service limits", "current usage", "request quota increase", "quota exceeded", "validate capacity", "regional availability", "provisioning limits", "vCPU limit", "how many vCPUs available in my subscription".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查和管理 Azure 配额与使用量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理 Azure 配额确保资源可用
copy.tagline_en: Check and manage Azure quotas and usage
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage Azure quotas to ensure resource availability

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 az quota 命令行查询你订阅里各类资源的配额上限、当前用量和剩余可用量,对比不同区域的容量,并在需要时提交配额提升请求。
howto.when: 当你提到「check quotas」「service limits」「current usage」等关键词,或要做部署规划、区域选择等容量校验时触发。

say.text: 查一下 eastus 的 Microsoft.Compute 配额和可用量
say.note: 返回各项配额的上限、用量和剩余

say.text: 对比 eastus 和 westus2 的 vCPU 可用配额
say.note: 按区域列出限值、用量与剩余

say.text: 把 eastus 的 standardDSv3Family 配额提到 500
say.note: 提交提升请求并返回状态

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude uses the az quota CLI to check Azure quota limits, current usage and available capacity in your subscription, compare capacity across regions, and file quota increase requests.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention “check quotas”, “service limits”, “current usage” and similar, or when planning deployments, choosing regions or validating capacity.

say_en.text: Check the Microsoft.Compute quota and available capacity in eastus
say_en.note: Returns limit, usage and availability per quota

say_en.text: Compare available vCPU quota between eastus and westus2
say_en.note: Lists limit, usage and remaining per region

say_en.text: Raise the standardDSv3Family quota in eastus to 500
say_en.note: Files the increase request and shows status
